general.positiveAdvance: Any missing required output, invalid RAW, unresolved material label, unauthorized retry, or custody/integrity failure prevents positive advancement; do not shrink denominator.
general.unhandledException: record stage, error class, timestamp and nonsecret message in append-only technical record; no caller-level catch that manufactures an output

cases.timeout: record TIMEOUT; no parse, no edited_text, no retry, no substitute output
cases.malformedOutput: record MALFORMED_OUTPUT including strict-schema parse failure, empty edited_text, over 60000 characters, multiple/ambiguous outputs, refusal or incomplete response; no repair or retry
cases.modelUnavailable: record MODEL_UNAVAILABLE; stop new Astra calls pending integrity review; do not switch model alias or silently resume
cases.apiOrServiceError: record API_OR_SERVICE_ERROR and available request ID/status; no retry or replacement
cases.schemaFailure: record SCHEMA_FAILURE; no output; no permissive parser, coercion or text extraction fallback
cases.infrastructureFailure: record INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE; no model call if request contract or secure exact-payload recorder failed before dispatch; if failure after dispatch, preserve attempt count and do not call again

astra.validOutput: only strict object with exactly one string edited_text, nonempty and <=60000 characters; preserve exact parsed text without trim, normalization or repair
astra.modelIdentityFailure: If response exposes a model identity inconsistent with frozen requested alias/accepted serving contract, block output use and integrity-review; never reinterpret it after outcomes.

v15.preflightThrows: invalid request/objective, account-backed zero-incremental-cost guard, or same editor/verifier object throws before native result; record V15_PREFLIGHT_FAILURE; no fabricated FINAL
v15.editorTimeoutOrCallerThrow: frozen function catches and returns source-fallback with timeout or editor-unavailable reason; preserve that exact native result, but RAW is absent and Candidate C is not run
v15.invalidEditorSchemaOrEmptyText: frozen function returns source-fallback with invalid-candidate when safeParse/empty check fails; preserve; RAW invalid/absent for common-RAW benchmark and Candidate C not run
v15.deterministicRejection: frozen control rejects or attempts its one local repair under published logic; preserve resulting trace and FINAL
v15.verifierMissingMalformedTimeoutOrCallerT: frozen inspect path returns source-fallback or repair path result with its published verifier-unavailable, verifier-malformed, invalid-verifier or timeout reason; preserve exact result and trace, never treat missing verification as PASS
v15.repairMissingMalformedTimeoutOrCallerThr: frozen path returns source-fallback with repair-unavailable, repair-failed or timeout as published; preserve exact result and attempt trace
v15.recorderOrStoreFailure: recorder failure can be caught by the frozen function as caller failure. The harness must retain an independent recorder-health failure marker and classify this as infrastructure integrity failure even if frozen function returns source fallback; no output is certified exact.
v15.unhandledAfterNativeReturn: record technical/integrity failure; no replacement result

candidateC.missingOrInvalidSharedRaw: do not invoke C if V15 exact saved RAW is absent/invalid or equality assertion fails; record C_NO_VALID_SHARED_RAW, no fabricated C FINAL
candidateC.preflightThrows: invalid arm/request/objective, zero-incremental-cost guard, or invalid timeout throws; record C_PREFLIGHT_FAILURE; no fabricated FINAL
candidateC.ambiguousObjective: frozen code returns abstained source with ambiguous-objective-authority reason; preserve native status/disclosure/trace
candidateC.invalidRawInsideNativePath: frozen code marks invalid-raw and abstains; harness common-RAW gate normally prevents this invocation; preserve if observed and mark binding deviation
candidateC.deterministicRejectionOrNoLocalRepair: frozen code follows its own abstention/repair path; preserve native result
candidateC.verifierMissingMalformedTimeoutOrCallerT: frozen inspect records trace.technicalFailure and returns unsafe; C may abstain with the published disclosure; preserve result and technical marker
candidateC.repairMissingMalformedTimeoutOrCallerThr: frozen path records trace.technicalFailure or repair-unavailable and abstains; preserve native result and attempt trace
candidateC.recorderOrStoreFailure: independent recorder-health marker makes this infrastructure integrity failure even if native C catches it and abstains; no exact-output certification

source.failure: If exact frozen source bytes cannot be copied and hashed to FINAL, record SOURCE_INTEGRITY_FAILURE; do not normalize, reconstruct or use a model.

deviationScope.documentedSingleArmTechnicalAbsence: affected pairs descriptive only; no positive advancement under 48/48
deviationScope.unresolvedJudgment: affected comparison descriptive/inconclusive; no positive advancement
